title: 第20章 楚家姐妹
novel_title: 觉醒阴阳神功：分手后我爽麻了
content_zh:
另一边，车子驶离江河别墅区，开出不远，就缓缓停在路边。

    桃夭从前面的商务车上下来，陈阳也紧跟着从宋萌萌的车上走了下来。

    桃夭走到陈阳面前，微微躬身，语气恭敬：“陈少，人已经安全解救出来了，我就先回去给梅姐复命了。”

    陈阳看着她，语气真诚：“多谢美女出手相助，不然我们今晚真的麻烦了。”

    桃夭忍不住笑了笑，眉眼舒展，语气柔和了许多：“陈少，我叫桃夭，你不用这么客气，叫我名字就行。

    帮你，也是梅姐的意思。”

    陈阳点了点头，想起肖明轩刚才的话，语气带着几分疑惑：“桃夭，刚才肖明轩说他哥，他哥到底叫什么名字？”

    桃夭脸上露出几分意外，挑眉说：“陈少不知道？他哥叫肖明枭。”

    陈阳追问：“这个肖明枭，很厉害吗？”

    桃夭轻轻点了点头，神色变得凝重了一些：“他有点势力，而且势力不小，在莞城扎根多年，和我们梅姐一直是井水不犯河水，互不干涉对方的事情。

    今晚要不是为了帮你，我们也不会轻易去得罪他。”

    陈阳心中了然，刚才他就注意到，桃夭带人干趴肖明轩的手下时，并没有对肖明轩本人动手，显然是不想彻底得罪肖明枭。

    陈阳点了点头说：“桃夭，那你回去以后，替我好好谢谢梅姐，明天我再亲自去找她道谢。”

    桃夭点了点头：“好的陈少，我一定把你的话带到。

    那我就先回去复命了。”

    陈阳微微颔首，目视着桃夭和手下们上车，看着他们的车子驶离，才缓缓转过身。

    宋萌萌这时从车上走了下来，脸上满是担忧，快步走到陈阳身边，语气急切：“陈阳，刚才真是太危险了，你没事吧？

    我们接下来会不会有麻烦？”

    陈阳安慰：“嫂子，我没事，别担心，有我在，不会有麻烦的。

    我们先回去，具体的事情，回去再说。”
content_en:
On the other side, the car drove away from the Jianghe Villa area and parked slowly on the roadside not far away.

Tao Yao got off the business car in front, and Chen Yang got off Song Mengmeng's car shortly after.

Tao Yao walked up to Chen Yang, bowed slightly, and said in a respectful tone: "Mr. Chen, the person has been rescued safely. I will go back to restore Sister Mei's life first."

Chen Yang looked at her and said in a sincere tone: "Thank you, beauty, for your help, otherwise we would be in real trouble tonight."

Taoyao couldn't help but smile, her eyebrows relaxed, and her tone became much softer: "Mr. Chen, my name is Taoyao, you don't have to be so polite, just call me by my name.

Helping you is what Sister Mei means."

Chen Yang nodded, remembering Xiao Mingxuan's words just now, his tone was a little confused: "Taoyao, just now Xiao Mingxuan said his brother, what is his brother's name?"

Tao Yao's face showed a bit of surprise, and she raised her eyebrows and said, "Young Master Chen, don't you know? His brother's name is Xiao Mingxiao."

Chen Yang asked: "Is this Xiao Mingxiao very powerful?"

Tao Yao nodded slightly, and his expression became more solemn: "He is a bit powerful, and his power is not small. He has taken root in Guancheng for many years. He and our sister Mei have always been on the same page and do not interfere in each other's affairs.

If it weren't for helping you tonight, we wouldn't offend him easily."

Chen Yang knew it in his heart. He had just noticed that when Taoyao led his men to kill Xiao Mingxuan's men, he did not attack Xiao Mingxuan himself. Obviously, he did not want to completely offend Xiao Mingxiao.

Chen Yang nodded and said, "Taoyao, when you go back, thank Sister Mei for me. I will go to her in person tomorrow to thank her."

Taoyao nodded: "Okay, Mr. Chen, I will bring your words to you.

Then I will go back and resume my life first."

Chen Yang nodded slightly, watched Taoyao and his men get into the car, watched their car drive away, and then slowly turned around.

Song Mengmeng stepped out of the car at this time, her face full of worry, and walked quickly to Chen Yang, her voice urgent: "Chen Yang, it was really dangerous just now, are you okay?

Will we be in trouble next?"

Chen Yang comforted: "Sister-in-law, I'm fine, don't worry, as long as I'm here, there won't be any trouble.

Let’s go back first, and we’ll talk about the specific things later."
